reviewed_by: Static review of the retail instruction sequence against the corrected candidate source

checks.name: function_identity
checks.rationale: Radare2 (4 blocks/4 edges, 57 bytes, cdecl), the existing Binary Ninja record and angr CFGFast agree on entry 0x004137A0 and on the 0x004137D7 self-loop; the candidate implements that entry.

checks.name: abi_and_return
checks.rationale: The native takes no arguments and is cdecl. Its success return value is Qvm_Cleanup's EAX, which 0x004137C0-0x004137C4 leaves untouched; the candidate returns that value as int32_t. The only retail caller (0x004020D3) discards it.

checks.name: path_literal
checks.rationale: The literal at 0x00539188 is exactly `LOCAL:humanplayer/humanplayer.qsc`; the candidate passes the same text to Qvm_Load.

checks.name: call_order
checks.rationale: Retail calls Qvm_Load, then Qvm_Execute, then Qvm_Cleanup, and cleans 8 bytes at 0x004137C6; the candidate calls the same three functions in the same order and ignores the Qvm_Execute result exactly as retail does.

checks.name: error_path
checks.rationale: The failure format at 0x00539150 is `HumanPlayer_LoadParameters: Couldn't load script "%s"` and the substitution is the same path literal; Debug_Error receives (format, path) in that order, matching the cdecl varargs call at 0x004137CC-0x004137D4.

checks.name: no_return_failure
checks.rationale: Retail does not return after Debug_Error: it jumps to 0x004137D7, which jumps to itself. The candidate uses `for (;;) {}` with no condition, which compiles to the same self-loop with no exit.

checks.name: no_invented_probing
checks.rationale: The previous body probed the resource system with std::filesystem and Resource_OpenFile and then executed a COMMON/humanplayer/humanplayer.qsc path. No such probe exists in retail; the candidate body contains only Qvm_Load/Qvm_Execute/Qvm_Cleanup and the documented fatal path.

differences: None functional. The candidate restores a callee-saved register before the success return where retail re-pushes its esi copy.
status_limits: Static and structural evidence only. The failure path's halt means no runtime capture of the fatal branch was made; the unit is not part of the linked candidate image.
